text:
Ana Morales: Heads-up 1 1 we need an APAC-safe benchmark visual pack for the upcoming webinar + launch posts. Must include brand + legal conservative variant, localization-ready layers, and routing for the webinar form. Deadlines: Figma first pass by Tue EOD, exports Thu noon.
Lina Chen: Noted. Deliverables request: hero comparison tile (side-by-side bars showing p95 latency + cost/1k), 2 social micro-tiles (1:1), a 1-slide keynote-ready image with CTA, and a compact animated micro (Lottie/GIF) for LinkedIn. Also need SVG icon set & mono patterned fallback.
Priya Kapoor: Messaging: produce two headline layers 1 marketing and conservative. Marketing headline: "Serve smarter: predictable latency, efficient unit cost." Conservative: "Competitive unit economics with stable latency." Legal will review conservative layer before publishing in APAC.
Kate Rivera: Brand rules: primary accent Approved Blue #0A6CF0; logo clearspace per Brand Kit v2. Provide SVGs and flattened PNGs. All exports must pass AA contrast; aim for AAA on caption text. No heavy decorative gradients on hero. Provide alt text for every asset.
Samir Desai: Localization needs: include a separate Figma text layer per language and avoid rasterized text in key graphics. We'll need JP/KO/ZH/EN final strings by Thu AM. Also request a second hero output with no superlatives for regulated regions.
Design-Bot: Figma stub created: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/apac-bench-pack. Export presets embedded: hero 1200x630 PNG @2x (sRGB, max 1.5MB), micro 1080x1080 PNG, animated micro: Lottie JSON + GIF fallback (max 150KB web), slide: 1920x1080 PNG + PPTX master. Include frame "alt_text.csv".
Lina Chen: Design clarifications: Which metrics exactly? p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec throughput, and cost per 1k tokens? Also should the hero show absolute numbers or percent delta vs Hosted baseline?
Mike Patel (via thread): Use p95 and p50; tokens/sec; cost per 1k tokens. Use Hosted as baseline and show percent delta badge (e.g., "-33% cost"). I'll DM exact sample numbers.
Priya Kapoor: Legal ask: avoid absolute claims like "lowest cost". Any cost deltas must be shown as illustrative ranges and include a notes link. On slides show a metadata strip: "Model: open-llm-7B 00-seq128; test harness: see notes." Website should hide the harness link behind a disclosure modal.
Jordan Lee: Routing: slide CTA must map to the webinar form with tag bench_apac_launch_2026 and utm_campaign=bench_apac. I'll update routing once assets are live; provide CSV mapping of CTA text -> dest -> lead tag.
Localization-Bot: Reminder: please keep lines under 45 characters where possible for JP/KO wrapping. Provide a spreadsheet with source strings and context screenshots.
Kate Rivera: Accessibility extras: include a patterned mono fallback for print and a high-contrast SVG icon set for screen readers. Validate green/red delta badges for colorblind-safe palette.
Lina Chen: Timeline: I'll post first Figma frames Tue EOD. I'll add layers: "conservative_copy", "localization_frames", "motion_ready" (Lottie-friendly). Will reserve 320x160px monospace area on the slide for a code snippet. Dark-mode variants included.
Samir Desai: I'll prepare APAC conservative copy and hand translations to Localization-Bot when the Figma frames are ready. Need translations back by Thu noon.
Design-Bot: Uploaded stubs to /s3/marketing/apac/5987654321_stubs.zip (marketing-team perms). Checklist: [x] Figma file, [ ] alt_text.csv, [ ] exported assets, [ ] routing csv. PRD: https://internal.redwood/ops/apac-bench-prd
Ana Morales: Thanks 1 post Figma links/screenshots here for quick QA. Marketing will QA copy; Design runs visual QC; Jordan owns routing wiring; Samir & Localization handle translations. Ping if blockers. :art::globe_with_meridians:
